files.description: Hourly weather for the city, September 2025 (720 rows, one per hour in time order, no gaps): observed_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), temp_c (degrees C, one decimal; about 2% empty), rain_mm (one decimal), wind_kmh (whole number), sky (clear, cloudy, fog or rain; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: In weather_hourly.csv, fill each empty temp_c by straight-line interpolation in time between the nearest non-empty hours before and after it. `result` should be a Series holding only the filled values, rounded to 2 decimals, indexed by observed_at as written in the file, in time order.
intended_computation: Read weather_hourly.csv; for each empty temp_c, linear interpolation in time between the nearest non-empty hours before and after; a Series holding only the filled values, rounded to 2 decimals, indexed by observed_at as written, in time order.
